message: 結成!!　流星クルセイダース

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... Yeah, this... sound of noodle-making. There's no mistake--」

name: Synn
message: 「It's Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Morning, Prez!」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning... but I'm still sleepy...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you talking about? You'd normally be long awake by now.」
I was up unusually late last night. If I remember right--

name: Paqy
message: 「Countin' on ya, Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「So what's this Demon Lord stuff supposed to mean?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, ya see...」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh-huh...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I forgot.」

name: Synn
message: 「And you call yourself a familiar...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Shut it! Who's got time to remember useless crap like that?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Fine, whatever. Anyway, keep this a secret from everyone. Especially you--you're a plushie, so you can't talk. Keep quiet.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Cunningly coverin' up your evil scheme, just as expected of the Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you to stop calling me 'Demon Lord'!」
That whole back-and-forth left me sleep-deprived.
But anyway, this was all just a dream... right?

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, so damn loud... What's with all this noise?」

name: Synn
message: 「It wasn't a dream!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, get up!」
Nanaka yanks off my futon, and I'm completely busted.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, Synn?! Why are you sleeping with a plushie?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek, don't look!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Since when did you become such a fairytale boy?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Th-This was a gift from my dad!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your birthday isn't for a while, is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I think... he probably gave it to me while he still had the money.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A panda plushie, huh... Your uncle is as weird as ever.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh! Impressive that you could tell I was a panda.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's obvious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「--Did that panda just talk?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, it's all over now. Farewell, my sparkling high school life.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, no helping it now that I'm busted. Prepare to be amazed--I am the Great Sage Paqy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whatever. You want some soba too?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heck yeah, I won't turn down free food!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, Nanaka! Aren't you surprised that a plushie is talking?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「More importantly, go take care of that thing at the entrance.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks as always, mister!」
A bottle to wake up--chugging the delivered milk in one go.

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」
Then, straight into the yard.

name: Synn
message: 「There, there, good girl.」
Searching the chicken coop, but--

name: Synn
message: 「No eggs today either, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, do you want some milk too?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't want it! Give it to that panda!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sweet, don't mind if I do!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey. Don't you think there's something a little weird about this panda?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You and I are both still half-asleep. Here you go, order's up!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooh, fresh-made and freshly boiled! What about mine?!」

name: Synn
message: 「No need to rush. Looks like there's plenty for you too.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Bon appetit!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Slurrrrrpp!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa, this is freaking delicious!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Chewy noodles, perfectly boiled, rich broth, and a sharp kick of wasabi!」

name: Paqy
message: 「And no seaweed on top, so you can really taste the soba. Man, it's been a while since I had soba this damn good!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hoho~ A plushie who appreciates fine soba is a rare sight indeed.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're exaggerating...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, it tastes kinda nostalgic, but I can't remember for the life of me where I've eaten it before.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Have you been to my place before?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't be stupid! As if any shop would serve food to a plushie!」

name: Synn
message: 「At least he's self-aware...」

name: Paqy
message: 「To show my respect, I'm calling you Soba from today on!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't mock me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Slurp.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoaaaa, that stings!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooooh, that wasabi really clears the sinuses.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that definitely woke my eyes right up.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Slurrrrrrrrrpp! Ahhhh~~ So good! I can't get enough of this~~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, a panda is talking. Guess I really am awake.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Always quick to turn away from reality. Ah, to be young.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't wanna hear that from a plushie.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Was it really okay to leave that thing behind?」

name: Synn
message: 「I couldn't exactly bring it to school.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It talks and moves around, though! Who knows what it'll do if you leave it alone?」

name: Synn
message: 「Despite how it looks, it actually seems to listen to what I say.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know pandas are omnivores, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, is that so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you gonna do if it raids your fridge?!」

name: Synn
message: 「There's only milk and a deodorizer in there anyway.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh yeah, good point.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a plushie, so it'll be fine.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Okay, I won't worry then. In fact, it's free to drink all the milk!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure you already know, but this stays a secret between just the two of us, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just... the two of us, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yup, exactly.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's up? You've been in an awfully good mood for a while now.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, really?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did something good happen?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well... I guess you could say something good happened.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If something good happened to the Student Council President, then it's only fair if something good happened to the Treasurer too!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's true. For example, not having to wake up early!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Yeah, yeah, sure it is.\s10」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Was I wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Honestly, that's so like you, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Was that a compliment?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It wasn't a compliment!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eek!」
「Oof!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow, ow, ow...」

name: Misa
message: 「Owwwww. I'm so sorry...」

name: Misa
message: 「--Wait, Sakura-kun!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Misa... Good morning.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey... It's dangerous to just stand around daydreaming in the middle of the street!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mornin', Vice President!」

name: Misa
message: 「G-Good morning!!」
If I remember correctly, in times like this--

name: Synn
message: 「May I have your hand, milady?」

name: Misa
message: 「M-Milady?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, wait. Are you okay? Are you hurt? Can you stand up?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't worry about me! I can stand up on my own from just this much.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, sorry, but... could you get off the thing you're sitting on?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My, when did that happen?」
My bag had been squashed flat underneath Misa's butt.

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, I'm so sorry!」
She flusteredly hands it back to me.

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly... At least hold onto your bag properly when you walk!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're here early. As expected of the vice president!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph! Look who's talking--」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, don't tell me you two were thinking the exact same thing as me...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm not losing to you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, there she goes.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The vice president's full of energy this morning, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「If you keep calling her 'vice president,' she's gonna get mad at you again.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mmm... It'll be fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh! Look at them doing morning practice!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Welcome to your new school life, Part-Timer Boy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Becoming the Student Council President has its perks, like being able to get to school early.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if we come early, it's not like there's actually anything to do, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Does the Sweets Club not have morning practice?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If there were any shops open at this hour, we totally would!」

name: Synn
message: 「So basically, never.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not true! It's just that there aren't any shops like that in Ryuusei Town!」

name: Synn
message: 「How peaceful...」
It feels like a dream that a fierce battle took place here just last night.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn. What were you up to with Ria-senpai after that yesterday?」
Can she read minds? As expected of a childhood friend.

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, you see... How should I put it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I get it, I get it! You had Ria-senpai helping you out, right?」
It was actually the other way around, but I'll just go with that.

name: Nanaka
message: 「She used to help me out a lot, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The teacher told me to pull together the accounting handover files, so I just whipped something up quick...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But it was full of calculation errors, so I got chewed out big time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let me guess, calculator mistakes?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep. But Senpai saved my butt back then. Plus, she even offered to do it together.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'd read out the amounts, and Senpai would tap away furiously on the calculator...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you're more of an abacus person after all, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai really knew her stuff, so she was crazy fast. Thanks to her, we finished in no time. Afterward, we had tea and just kicked back and relaxed.」

name: Synn
message: 「As expected of Ria-senpai. She can handle anything when it comes to the Student Council.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wonder if being from a business owner's family forces you to be reliable like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think that's necessarily why.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, true.」
Regardless of her upbringing, Ria-senpai has a natural influence on everyone.
It wasn't just yesterday, and it wasn't just me--she's helped out in all sorts of places up until now.
I guess this is what it truly means to have the qualities of a Student Council President.

name: Female Student
message: 「Good morning~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, oh, good morning!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Someone you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I don't know her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Way to go, Student Council President! You're a total celebrity!」

name: Synn
message: 「Do I really stand out that much...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't be shy, don't be shy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ouch, hey, that hurts!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Work hard so you don't lose to your upperclassman!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Nanaka. Where are you going?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The Student Council room. No one's gonna be in the classroom at this hour anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I see.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, those desks are lame.」

name: Synn
message: 「The desks?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Geesh, this is why you're an amateur.」

name: Synn
message: 「An amateur at what?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good morniiiing!」

name: Misa
message: 「No way...!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Vice President. What are you looking at?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that the logbook?」

name: Misa
message: 「To think it was already too late... and it's squeaky clean, too...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If anything, it's squeaky-squeaky clean.」

name: Misa
message: 「Lost again...」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's nothing! See you then!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh my.」

name: Synn
message: 「And off she goes again.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wasn't she holding a broom?」
So she was planning to clean.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Take a seaaat!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't be so rough... You're gonna break the sofa.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What, are you trying to say I'm fat?」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you want me to?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I'm kidding, I'm kidding!」
I sat down on the sofa next to Nanaka.

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's nice and quiet here! Gets plenty of sunlight, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's the Student Council room for you. Perks of being the Student Council President, I guess?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe so~」

name: Synn
message: 「Though I'd be much happier with free cafeteria meals.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm, yeah, true...」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess to get something like that, I'd really have to work way harder.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, let's work hard together--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm?」
Soft hair lightly touched my shoulder.

name: Synn
message: 「She fell asleep.」
I guess it makes sense. Nanaka wakes up way earlier than me, makes soba in the morning, and then goes to school...
Maybe she was always sleeping in the classroom at this time of day.
The desks in the Student Council room are just at the right height to sleep on. But her pillow right now is my shoulder.

name: Synn
message: 「Heh, she really is hopeless.」
I slowly adjusted my body so I wouldn't wake her.
I put my jacket over her so she wouldn't catch a cold.

name: Synn
message: 「There, all set.」
Come to think of it, it's been a really long time since I walked to school with Nanaka.
Ever since coming to this academy, my mornings were always a blur of working my part-time job and sprinting to school.
Naturally, there was no time to just walk slowly and chat like we did today.
Back in the day, it was so normal I never noticed, but being together really is way more fun than being alone.
Is this what they call a normal academy life?
Alright! Step by step, I'm getting closer to that brilliant, sparkling academy life!

name: Synn
message: 「I'd better go give everyone my morning greeting right away!」

name: Synn
message: 「After all, I am the Student Council President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Good morning, everyone!」

name: Female Student
message: 「Morning~」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm Synn Sakura, Student Council President. Good morning!」

name: Female Student
message: 「Good morning!」

name: Synn
message: 「Good morning, everyone!」

name: Female Student
message: 「Morning to you. Do your best, Kaichou-han.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much!」
I exchange greetings with the passing students. For some reason, I start to feel refreshed.

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm?」
An unfamiliar car drives up the hill and stops in front of the school gate.

name: Synn
message: 「What's that...?」
I instinctively rush over. I mean, I've never seen a car like this before!

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know what it's called, but it sure looks expensive!」
A woman dressed in a dignified tuxedo--which also looks quite expensive--opens the door.

name: Woman
message: 「My Lady. Please watch your step.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huuuh... I'm so sleepy...」
As expected of a young lady. To think she gets chauffeured in a car like this.

name: Synn
message: 「M-Morning, Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good morning. Um... Mr. Igarashi? No, Mr. Degarashi...?」

name: Synn
message: 「No! It's Synn! Synn Sakura!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, the Student Council President...」
She totters along as she walks.

name: Synn
message: 「You look really sleepy, are you okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm fine~」
In Lolotte's path, a banana peel mysteriously awaits. It lies there as if specifically set up as a trap.

name: Synn
message: 「Watch out!」
However, right before Lolotte can step on the banana peel, the woman from earlier swiftly snatches it away.

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave My Lady's safety to me, her butler, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you, Jiiya.」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing...! So this is a real-deal high-society young lady!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, regarding today's schedule...」
It seems her schedule is completely managed for her.

name: Riesling
message: 「Today's schedule: dinner at 19:00. Bedtime at 21:00. That is all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is this the bourgeois life...?!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady, shall I pick you up at the usual time today as well?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Ah, excuse me...!」
Lolotte looked somewhat bored, so I couldn't help but speak up.

name: Synn
message: 「Won't she be late because of the Student Council meeting?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah! Come to think of it, that's right!」

name: Riesling
message: 「If it is for the Student Council, then it cannot be helped.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wouldn't it be fine to just contact you when it's over?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're right! I'll do that!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Understood. I shall inform the Master as well.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, the Student Council is so wonderful! I feel so happy I could float up to heaven!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-Heavens!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am glad to hear that, Milady.」
The butler offered a serene smile, smoothly stepped into the car, and stepped on the accelerator.

name: Synn
message: 「So you really do have a curfew.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Up until now, every day I had to go straight home right after classes and club trial sessions.」

name: Synn
message: 「Being a rich young lady must be tough in its own way.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But if it's the Student Council, it's fine. After all, it's such a meaningful and noble activity!」

name: Synn
message: 「Noble, huh... Guess I'd better work harder, then.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! That's just what I want!」

name: Synn
message: 「--Achoo!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you dress like that, you'll catch a cold, President-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I've gotta go wake Nanaka up! See you after school, then.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. I can't wait for after school♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why didn't you wake me up?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you looked like you were sleeping so peacefully.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right... Thanks.」
I open my bag to pull out a textbook.
This soft, smooth, marshmallow-like texture and touch... Don't tell me...

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I knew it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Look at this.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa!」
Paqy is squished inside my bag. Must've happened when Misa sat on it.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Its eyes rolled back in its head.」

name: Synn
message: 「It doesn't even have whites in its eyes.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why not just leave it like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Still, I wonder when it even snuck in...」
